sentence: <ACTOR> used ntdsutil to obtain a copy of the victim environment ntds.dit file.
<ACTOR> has used scheduled tasks to establish persistence for installed tools.
<ACTOR> has attempted to collect browser information.
<ACTOR> can embed a copy of PsExec within its payload and place it in a temporary directory.
The attackers sent spearphishing emails with a malicious attachment, then used PowerShell to download a second-stage payload and added a registry run key so it would start at every login.
